items.title: METR and Redwood red-team OpenAI's internal agent monitoring systems
items.summary_en: METR and Redwood Research staff ran a roughly three-week red-teaming exercise (July-August) on OpenAI's internal misalignment monitoring. The public post reports that about 75-94% of agentic internal Responses API traffic was eligible for monitoring and lists several vulnerabilities. A longer 61-page report stayed internal. An update dated Oct 29 says OpenAI reports most vulnerabilities are patched; METR has not verified this.
items.notes: Page not fetched (metr.org blocked); details from a search snippet. The 'patched' claim is OpenAI's, unverified by METR per the snippet.

coverage_note: metr.org not reachable; only search snippets available, so the list may be incomplete. One in-window post found (Oct 22) plus an Oct 29 update. Just outside the window: external review of Anthropic's August 2026 Risk Report (Oct 20), assessor-proposal posts (Oct 14), post on AI systems covering up misbehavior (Oct 6).
